groups.sql:
SELECT anon_1.gid, anon_1.kind, anon_1.amount, anon_1.paid, anon_1.count, anon_1.start, anon_1."end", anon_1.category, anon_1.day 
FROM (SELECT expenses.group_id AS gid, %(param_1)s AS kind, sum(expenses.amount) AS amount, sum(CASE WHEN (expenses.paid_by = %(paid_by_1)s::UUID) THEN expenses.amount ELSE %(param_2)s END) AS paid, count(expenses.id) AS count, min(expenses.expense_date) AS start, max(expenses.expense_date) AS "end", %(param_3)s AS category, CAST(%(param_4)s AS DATE) AS day 
FROM expenses 
WHERE expenses.group_id IN (%(group_id_1_1)s::UUID) AND expenses.is_deleted IS false GROUP BY expenses.group_id UNION ALL SELECT expenses.group_id AS gid, %(param_5)s AS kind, sum(expense_splits.amount) AS amount, %(param_6)s AS paid, %(param_7)s AS count, %(param_8)s AS start, %(param_9)s AS "end", %(param_10)s AS category, CAST(%(param_11)s AS DATE) AS day 
FROM expenses JOIN expense_splits ON expense_splits.expense_id = expenses.id 
WHERE expenses.group_id IN (%(group_id_1_1)s::UUID) AND expenses.is_deleted IS false AND expense_splits.user_id = %(user_id_1)s::UUID GROUP BY expenses.group_id UNION ALL SELECT expenses.group_id AS gid, %(param_12)s AS kind, sum(expenses.amount) AS amount, %(param_13)s AS paid, %(param_14)s AS count, %(param_15)s AS start, %(param_16)s AS "end", expenses.category AS category, CAST(%(param_17)s AS DATE) AS day 
FROM expenses 
WHERE expenses.group_id IN (%(group_id_1_1)s::UUID) AND expenses.is_deleted IS false GROUP BY expenses.group_id, expenses.category UNION ALL SELECT expenses.group_id AS gid, %(param_18)s AS kind, sum(expenses.amount) AS amount, %(param_19)s AS paid, %(param_20)s AS count, %(param_21)s AS start, %(param_22)s AS "end", %(param_23)s AS category, expenses.expense_date AS day 
FROM expenses 
WHERE expenses.group_id IN (%(group_id_1_1)s::UUID) AND expenses.is_deleted IS false GROUP BY expenses.group_id, expenses.expense_date) AS anon_1 ORDER BY anon_1.amount DESC, anon_1.category

users_1.default_currency AS users_1_default_currency, users_1.personal_display_currency AS users_1_personal_display_currency, users_1.is_active AS users_1_is_active, users_1.email_verified AS users_1_updated_at, users_1.last_login AS users_1_last_login 
FROM users LEFT OUTER JOIN invitations ON lower(invitations.invitee_email) = lower(users.email) AND invitations.status = %(status_1)s AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM groups 
WHERE groups.id = invitations.group_id AND groups.is_active IS true)) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM group_members 
WHERE group_members.group_id = invitations.group_id AND group_members.user_id = %(user_id_1)s::UUID AND group_members.is_active IS true)) LEFT OUTER JOIN groups AS groups_1 ON groups_1.id = invitations.group_id LEFT OUTER JOIN users AS users_1 ON users_1.id = invitations.invited_by 
WHERE users.id = %(id_1)s::UUID ORDER BY invitations.created_at DESC, invitations.id DESC
